title: Mixed feelings about Things 3
body:
Everything in Things 3 is really great. I just found some minor things upon using it. Hope they consider these things since the app is a bit pricey.

1. Tasks (esp. daily routine) are not automatically organised according to time. You can reorganise it manually, but automatic sorting via time should be default.

2. Hope there’s a calendar for daily, weekly, monthly where you could track the timelines of where you input your tasks. It maybe helpful so you could track your free/taken time slot as well.

3. Possible app for PC as some of the task manager apps do have this feature not just for Mac. 

4. Bought this app for my iPhone not knowing you have to buy the iPad version separately. That’s sad.

Other than that, Things 3 is a great app.

title: Completely Redesigned
body:
I used Things 2 for months now. I knew of Things 3 but I didn’t buy immediately for some reason.

Now that I pulled the trigger, it’s a good thing Things 3 has an amazing onboarding process. Even though I used Things 2, I still got lost! This meant the app is different from the previous iteration.

And while you may be pulling the trigger from buying a simple to-do app, you're right. But remember, the cheapest worthy competitor is Todoist and even that costs $ 12/year. This app only costs $ 10 and it will last a lifetime.

Trust me, this company deserves to get your money.
